description: Hong Kong innovative biopharma. Bispecific platform. Ivonescimab (PD-1/VEGF) is the first drug to beat pembrolizumab head-to-head in phase III. The stock moves on HARMONi readouts (+15.8% to +37.5%). This is the name the 14-day abstract lead fits best.

pipeline_molecules.note: PD-1/VEGF bispecific. First head-to-head win versus pembrolizumab. HARMONi-2, HARMONi-3, and HARMONi-7 are phase III.
PD-1/CTLA-4 bispecific. First approved IO bispecific, 2022.

bd_partners.deal: Global rights to ivonescimab ex-China. US listing SMMT amplifies the move (SMMT rose 272% on a HARMONi disclosure).
